title: National Commission must formulate and hear appeal on substantial question of law
description: The National Commission must formulate and hear an appeal on a substantial question of law

content.what: must formulate and hear appeal on substantial question of law
conditions: substantial question of law is involved in the case
limitations: nothing in this sub-section shall be deemed to take away or abridge the power of the National Commission to hear, for reasons to be recorded in writing, the appeal on any other substantial question of law, if it is satisfied that the case involves such question of law.
